name: mcp-sqlserver
description: MCP server for DBAs running dozens of SQL Server instances: grouped connections, plans, indexes
long_description: One MCP entry for every SQL Server you administer. Connections live in a single connections.json grouped by client or environment, hot-reloaded without restarting the agent. Every response says which server and database answered it. Beyond running queries it returns execution plans, index layouts and stored-procedure source, so an agent can actually diagnose a slow query instead of guessing.

connections_file.title: connections.json
connections_file.description: File describing every SQL Server you want the agent to reach. See connections.template.json in the repository for the format.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all available SQL Server connections grouped by connectionGroup

tools.name: reload_connections
tools.description: Reload connections.json without restarting the MCP server

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query on the database

tools.name: get_execution_plan
